Voter roll revision exercise begins in Karnataka and other states

A Special Summary of Electoral Rolls (SIR) exercise, a voter roll revision process, has commenced in Karnataka and four other states. The process involves door-to-door verification and online/offline form submission. Concerns have been raised by some groups regarding 'anomaly' voters and the process itself, with protests planned. The final rolls are expected by October 7.
